chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithamī from Yunus ibn Ya'qub from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
About a woman whose milk flowed without giving birth, so she breastfed a girl and a boy with that milk. Is what is prohibited due to breast-feeding prohibited due to that milk? He said: No.
ai.seo_question: Does non-pregnancy milk establish breastfeeding prohibitions?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes that milk production independent of pregnancy or childbirth is sufficient to create *radhāʿ* (breastfeeding kinship) prohibitions. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic view that the physical act of nursing, rather than the biological source of the milk, determines the mahram relationship, thereby facilitating flexible application of marriage prohibitions in historical contexts.
